title: QA rota configuration
description: Human-curated QA eligibility per project. See ai-pm-platform/config/README.md for the full design (why this is a git file, what lives in Supabase instead, and how round-robin/overrides work). Edited by hand; the Automation Engine only reads this file, never writes it.

projects.description: Keyed by the project's Jira project key (matches projects.jira_project_key), e.g. "LT".

projectLead.description: Single email identifying the Project Lead. Configuration only -- CLAUDE.md §3a: no scheduled job reads this.

qaPool.description: Eligible QA people for this project, in round-robin order. Order matters: the Automation Engine cycles through this array using the cursor stored in Supabase (qa_rota_state.last_assigned_user_id), not a field in this file.

email.description: Matched against users.email to resolve the internal user id. Chosen over matching by display name, which risks typos/duplicates -- see the 2026-09-22 note in IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md task 2.2b.

name.description: Display name, for human readability only -- not used for matching.

available.description: Toggled by hand on leave/unavailability. Per CLAUDE.md §8: if round-robin lands on someone false here, the automation must surface an exception, not silently skip to the next person.
